drills.description: Execute stroke and hold finish for 3 seconds with chest over rear hip.
drills.focus: Controlled rotational balance without leaning away.

keyframe_pose.cue: Balanced ready stance, eyes level, hands resting comfortably at back hip
Backlift raised with top hand dominant, bat aligned along diagonal plane
Decisive foot commitment at -10° along pitch, head leading into stroke line
Rapid downward acceleration of wrists, lead arm guiding path into impact
Bottom hand wrist whip digs out yorker, uncoiling core into circular swirl
Rotational 360° helicopter swirl finishing high over left shoulder
Smooth recoil and balance recovery, resetting ready base inside crease
